check_box.label: Realistic Mouselook (camera follows head, body not locked)
check_box.name: FSRealisticMouselook
check_box.tool_tip: Binds the mouselook camera to the avatar's head instead of locking it to the avatar's center. The body is no longer held below the camera, animations play out fully and the avatar can move around while the camera follows.

slider.label: Mouselook rotate threshold (deg):
slider.name: AvatarRotateThresholdMouselook
slider.tool_tip: Angle between avatar facing and camera facing at which the avatar turns while in mouselook. Set to -1 to use the default mouselook behaviour.

check_box.label: Head and eyes follow mouse in Mouselook
check_box.name: FSMouselookHeadTracking
check_box.tool_tip: If enabled, the avatar's head and eyes follow the mouse cursor direction while in mouselook.

check_box.label: Experimental first-person aiming animation
